description: Undo ONE change of a project's calendar (an id from list_calendar_history), field by field: what is still as the change left it goes back; a field somebody changed since keeps their change, and the answer names that event under 'kept' with the fields and who. An event the change made goes (unless changed since); one it deleted comes back under its id. The rollback is a change of its own and can be undone the same way. Under the weekly ceiling of reconfigurations like any write. Anybody who may write in the project.

confirmOverCeiling.description: true to let the rollback take a week over the ceiling — only for somebody who configures the project.
